info.name: IRoad Mobile Driver — Job List Module
info.description:
# IRoad Mobile — Job List Module

## Prerequisites
1. Import **IRoad Mobile Driver Jobs — Local** environment.
2. Set `base_url`, `email`, `password`, optional `tenant_id`.
3. Run **Setup → Login**.
4. Run **Testing Flows → Flow A** (Collection Runner).

## Auth & tenant
| Item | Rule |
|------|------|
| **Authorization** | `Bearer {{access_token}}` |
| **Capability** | `mobile.driver.jobs` |
| **X-Tenant-ID** | Optional; must match JWT if sent |

## Docs
- `mobile_api/docs/driver_job_list.md`
- `postman/README-Jobs.md`

exec: console.warn('access_token empty — run Setup → Login first');
